inputs.value: VANGUARD-03: unmanned Marvel-inspired exploration probe about two metres across, tangible scientific machine rather than superhero costume. Low hexagonal deep-crimson body, flat graphite deck, satin-gold inset side panels. NO wheels. Three identical downward pulse-thruster housings form a balanced triangle firmly integrated beneath the body; fictional pulse lift enables low hover. Three short hinged landing legs attach around the lower rim with broad footpads clear of the outlets. One short central camera mast carries a dark lens block. One compact two-joint sampling arm attaches to a distinct FRONT panel, folded against it for travel; opposite rear panel plain. Matte red paint, dark heat-resistant nozzle rims, lightly brushed gold panels and tidy recessed fasteners. No cockpit, floating components, giant energy core or weapons.

Front-left three-quarter view at body height. Entire vehicle visible, front sampling tool on the near side, rear extending away. Arm folded into its travel cradle, propulsion hardware readable. Canonical baseline design.
For reference photography, rest the probe on its three extended landing legs on the white floor. Thrusters OFF, no glow or dust plume. Arm folded. Keep all three thruster housings, allowing natural occlusion.

Photograph of a tangible full-size robotic vehicle, not a miniature. Restrained saturation, natural tonal transitions, fine material texture. Matte painted panels, subdued brushed-metal reflections, small dark sensor lenses. A few recessed fasteners, narrow panel seams and protected pivots at plausible scale. Every instrument is securely mounted; each arm has one continuous chain of connected joints. Suspension and propulsion have clearance to move. Sealed opaque equipment housings, no cabin or passenger windows. Preserve silhouette, equipment placement and propulsion type. No glossy toy finish, theatrical bloom, captions or graphic overlays.

Engineering reference photograph on a seamless neutral WHITE floor and WHITE background. Soft broad light from above-left, gentle fill, faint contact shadow. Expose white body panels slightly darker than the backdrop so edges remain visible. Entire vehicle with clear margin, sharp focus across the body, moderate perspective like a 70mm lens. Clean baseline manufactured surfaces with subtle machining marks. No scenery, rocks, red dust, display pedestal or green reflections.
